Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614458 that have exact activity measurements (standard_relation '=' and standard_value is not null). Join assays to activities on assay_id, join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return all matching rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
